long-context-gates/README.md.content:
# K64 next bounded gates

Existing ordered native block5 host only, B1 active slot in unchanged widest-rung engine. Control is the original matched-arena scalar GF4 cubin; candidate is already block-qualified K64 QK-only. NS33, BF16 Q/K/V, scalar FP32 softmax/PV/merge, packet/PF/checkpoint/input remain unchanged.

The queue contains one unfiltered Compute Sanitizer memcheck of the original six saved native operator cells, then control/K64 captures at prefix8192 and32768. Every context capture has three staged hidden inputs and exact reset repeats. No library reference or timing is run. Memory command requires raw exit0 and one ERROR SUMMARY:0; any raw99 is a failure requiring a new explicit diagnosis, never blanket acceptance. Instrumented outputs and all partials must exactly match uninstrumented cells.

Short reads inspect current in.pos/in.kvlen, Q projection, K projection, post-RoPE Q, first2048 valid KV rows, all active partials/normalizers, attention output and block output. Every extent is checked against the unchanged packet and host 2MiB diagnostic limit. The KV probe proves equality only for the observed prefix; it does not claim whole-cache equality or inspect the latest cached K/V row. Current K projection is preserved in act.kg. Both context arms share identical frozen upstream code and assets.

Existing prefill setup uploads the synthetic hidden buffer once before the multi-chunk prefill call. At long contexts later chunk staging may consume prior computed activations. This is a deterministic native block stress history with required exact resets, not a claim of identical hidden input on every prefilling row. The same history is used for both arms.

Numerical checks remain attention relativeL2<=.003 and block relativeL2<=.01 plus maxabs<=.05+.02maxref. All requested bytes finite, complete six rows, exact observed upstream and reset repeats. Original full-network gate remains separate and unresolved. Timing remains held pending all numerical and memory gates.

CPU check: nix develop -c /opt/pytorch/bin/python3 long-context-gates/validate.py --self-test
GPU: root executes each frozen gpu-queue.json command serially, then its explicit validator_command. No generic bit-exact full-model validator.

# Explicit primary-context memory retry

Original unfiltered memory run remains FAILED raw99 with eight cuCtxGetDevice_v2 INVALID_CONTEXT201 reports. Four call stacks point to Torch capability/lazy initialization; four to first Torch CUDA allocation. No native launch appears in those stacks. The old logs/results are unchanged, and no error exemption is introduced.

The only execution change is an artifact Python launcher: checked cuInit → cuDeviceGet(0) → cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain → cuCtxSetCurrent → cuCtxGetCurrent/cuCtxGetDevice verification, then runpy executes the SHA-pinned original comparator unchanged. It retains the primary context until process exit, so Torch objects are not torn down after an early release. No CUDA context flags or kernel/DSO changes. CUDA header documents that retain activates but does not push the context, motivating the explicit binding call.

CPU mock tests verify exact API order, immediate failure propagation for every API, and rejection of null context or wrong current context/device. No GPU APIs are called by these tests.

One fresh unfiltered memcheck job uses the exact original six saved native operator cells. Raw exit0 and one ERROR SUMMARY:0 are required. Existing fixed numeric gates, finite/canary/exact repeat checks remain. All18 output/Opart/MLpart files must be byte-exact to the original uninstrumented run. Any API or device-access error still fails; no blanket99 acceptance. Timing remains held.

import ctypes as C

def initialize(driver):
 specs=[("cuInit",[C.c_uint]),("cuDeviceGet",[C.POINTER(C.c_int),C.c_int]),("cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain",[C.POINTER(C.c_void_p),C.c_int]),("cuCtxSetCurrent",[C.c_void_p]),("cuCtxGetCurrent",[C.POINTER(C.c_void_p)]),("cuCtxGetDevice",[C.POINTER(C.c_int)])]
 for name,args in specs:
  f=getattr(driver,name);f.argtypes=args;f.restype=C.c_int
 def call(name,*args):
  rc=getattr(driver,name)(*args)
  if rc:raise RuntimeError(f"{name} failed: {rc}")
 device=C.c_int(-1);ctx=C.c_void_p();current=C.c_void_p();actual=C.c_int(-1)
 call("cuInit",0);call("cuDeviceGet",C.byref(device),0)
 call("cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain",C.byref(ctx),device.value)
 if not ctx.value:raise RuntimeError("null primary context")
 call("cuCtxSetCurrent",ctx);call("cuCtxGetCurrent",C.byref(current));call("cuCtxGetDevice",C.byref(actual))
 if current.value!=ctx.value or actual.value!=device.value:raise RuntimeError("primary context binding mismatch")
 # Keep the primary-context retain alive through Torch and interpreter teardown.
 return driver,ctx
